name: epipilot
description: Evidence-driven epistemic research control for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run Codex as an evidence-driven research agent.
interface.longDescription: Persist goals, unknowns, falsifiable hypotheses, preregistered experiments and verified evidence outside chat context, then derive the next bounded research action from canonical state.
defaultPrompt: Use EpiPilot to investigate this research problem.
Build competing hypotheses and a discriminative experiment.
Show my current epistemic map and next action.
